PRESS TO ENTER

Ferrous

THE STUDIO IS OPEN. An independent record label operating out of Leeds since 2014, releasing between four and six records a year.

Everything is mastered at half speed and pressed on 180 gram vinyl at a plant we have used since the beginning. We do not licence to streaming services for the first ninety days.

Catalogue

Forty-one releases to date, of which nine remain in print. The back catalogue is repressed when demand justifies a run of five hundred.
